_doc: Route F2 additions to art/rosace/faces/wh2.json (read at run time and merged by stills_f2.py into <out>/<variant>/_faces.json, which wh2_px.py's face step reads instead of wh2.json). 'expressions': the two figure-pose appeal poses (the wh2 table is keyed by pose file name, and idle_appeal/back_appeal are not in it: they take idle_hero's and n2_pivot's). 'eyes_big': the 144 px eye stamps one column wider and one row taller (+14% wide, +17% tall; the iris gains a column and a row, the pupil a second pixel on the open eyes), same codes and the same construction as the wh2 stamps (two-row dark lid with the outer flick, 2-tone iris, pupil, catchlights). At 80 the wh2 eyes (3x3) stay: one pixel there is +33%, not +10-15%.
